name: sealed-circuits
description: Sealed SNARK redeem circuit (Spec B). See internal/specs/SPEC-snark-redeem-B.md and internal/docs/adr/0001-snark-prover-backend.md.

scripts.ptau:download: echo 'Download powersoftau .ptau file (e.g. powersOfTau28_hez_final_17.ptau for 2^17 constraints) into ./keys/ before running setup'
scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/redeem.r1cs keys/pot.ptau keys/redeem_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute keys/redeem_0000.zkey keys/redeem_final.zkey --name='Sealed v1 ceremony participant'
scripts.export-vk: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey keys/redeem_final.zkey keys/vk.json
scripts.prove: snarkjs groth16 fullprove input.json build/redeem_js/redeem.wasm keys/redeem_final.zkey proof.json public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify keys/vk.json public.json proof.json
